sections.name: Employee hero
sections.description: The last-hire claim as a centered hero: gradient-accented superlative headline, a three-verb cadence line set in the display face with a settling sans tail (Watches. Reasons. Ships.), dual CTA where the secondary is a watch-the-film ghost with a play glyph, and the trial fine print inside the hero. Poster variant sets the headline at --text-poster, the page's one poster statement.

usedBy.note: hero-centered-video: superlative hire headline, Learns/Improves/Delivers cadence sub, Start free + Watch the film pair, trial terms inside the hero

sections.name: Highlights grid
sections.description: The four-card operation grid: left-aligned intro, then flat sunken-fill cards each carrying a two-sentence claim (capability, then outcome) over a token-built product still: a morning-brief mini panel with a sparkline, a drafted-move card awaiting sign-off, an overnight change feed and an on-voice draft. The lead card sits on the accent tint; the lead-card variant stretches it full width with the still beside the claim.

sections.name: Voice learned
sections.description: The brand-voice proof as a before/after copy pane: a voice-check card holding two message samples, the generic one muted and tagged rejected, the on-voice one on the accent tint and tagged shipped, with a mono footer naming the voice-model source. Copy column explains that the voice is learned from already-shipped work.

sections.name: Always-on band

sections.name: Week in motion
sections.description: The pre-planned week as a Mon-Fri column strip: each day a card of queued task chips with channel badges riding the semantic Badge tones, exactly one chip on the accent tint flagged needs-your-sign-off, and an optional today column outlined in the accent with a mono TODAY tag. Plain variant drops the today marker.

sections.name: Agency compare
sections.description: Never-brief-an-agency-again contrast: two step cards side by side, the retainer way muted on the sunken fill with mono time and dollar costs, the Alfred way accent-outlined with second-and-tap costs, closed by a row of mono delta pills (2 wks to same morning, $8,500/mo to one plan). Alfred-first variant swaps the card order.
